title: Global nonlinear stability of the 2D incompressible viscous non-resistive MHD under sheared magnetic field
summary: We study the two-dimensional incompressible viscous non-resistive magnetohydrodynamics in the periodic strip $\mathbb T\times\mathbb R$, subject to a smooth sheared background magnetic field $(ξ(x_2),0)^{\top}$, where $ξ(x_2)$ is bounded and away from zero. For sufficiently smooth perturbations satisfying even-odd symmetry, we prove global-in-time well-posedness and nonlinear stability in Lagrangian coordinates.
